Bubble fraction for 1F1B (same as GPipe) = (p−1)/(m+p−1) of the step time, where p is the number of stages and m the number of micro-batches. Each stage works for m micro-batch slots out of m+p−1 total, so it idles for p−1 slots.

With p=8 and m=32: 7/(32+7) = 7/39 ≈ 0.1795.

The bubble is 7/32 ≈ 0.219 relative to ideal compute time. As a fraction of each stage's step time, it is 7/39.
